stem: What should alternative text for an informative image do?

options.text: Convey the purpose or information of the image
options.rationale: Describes what the image communicates in context.

options.text: Repeat the nearby caption word for word
List every color used in the image
options.rationale: Describing colors is rarely the purpose of the image.

options.text: Say that it is an image
options.rationale: The screen reader already announces that it is an image.

explanation: Alternative text should convey the purpose or information the image provides in its context. Repeating a nearby caption or describing every color is usually not helpful.
